svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Continuous use and many watchers on one daemon (release, stand-in model)
svg.desc: What grows with use, and how many watchers can one daemon serve?
svg.text: Continuous use and many watchers on one daemon (release, stand-in model)

g.title: CPU a turn: 48 points, lowest 16.6, median 140, highest 293

svg.text: Soak: two clients, each one growing session (a file read, then a reply; the stand-in answers in about 30 ms), 8 minutes.
Watchers: connections each watching one session, one turn on it; the stand-in streams for about 0.5 s.
